Subject: Debrief: Evan Morales — Senior Infra Engineer (on-site today)

Team — quick debrief from Evan's loop this morning. Key context: senior infra, 6+ years systems + k8s, onsite with Eng, Arch, and Prod Eng panel. Please drop a short score (1–5) across: technical, system design, collaboration, and hiring recommendation. Attachments: resume + my quick notes.

Highlights from my read:
- Strong debugging and runtime ops experience (K8s, long-tail CPU issues).
- System design answers were pragmatic but avoided deeper latency micro-optimizations.
- Culture fit: collaborative; referenced running postmortem automations at scale.

Ask: add your numeric scores inline and any quick guardrails (take-home, reference ask, spot-on hire).

Attachments: evan_morales_resume.pdf (resume), jordan_onsite-notes-evan.txt (inline notes stub)

Thanks,
Jordan

Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Evan Morales — Senior Infra Engineer (on-site today)

Jordan — thanks for the send. My quick scores below and a short rationale; attached a filled scorecard (evan_morales_scorecard.pdf).

Technical: 4 — solid systems chops, good troubleshooting examples, could have backed up some answers with more concrete metrics.
System design: 3 — pragmatic design, missed a couple low-latency knobs (trace sampling, sharding tradeoffs) but overall reasonable.
Collaboration: 5 — references to cross-team ops runbooks and clear ownership behaviors.
Recommendation: Move to take-home (focused on a timed infra exercise) before final offer.

Notes:
- Interviewer (Eng lead) felt comfortable with candidate escalation patterns.
- Would like 2 quick references focused on production incidents.

Attachments: evan_morales_scorecard.pdf (scorecard)

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Talent Org
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turn. Short answers:
- Ownership: the candidate clarified in Q&A that he led the metrics pipeline for two services end-to-end for ~18 months (ingest -> long-term store -> dashboards). He defined SLIs and ran a small on-call rotation. So that checks our ownership box.
- Plan: unanimous on a short take-home (3–4 hour infra exercise) + two reference checks focused on incident ownership. If take-home goes well, we proceed to offer (target: L5 comp band).

Marissa — can you own scheduling the take-home and grabbing the references? Recruiter ask to Talent Partners: please confirm Evan is available next week for the take-home window (we'll send a timed exercise and prefer Tues/Wed).

Evan — thanks again for coming in today. We'll follow up with a short timed exercise and two reference questions. Any constraints on next-week availability, reply-all and we'll accommodate.

Jordan
